comment: The libc entry points ForeignPty calls through java.lang.foreign, declared for the native image
builder. GraalVM 25 does NOT infer these: it registers zero downcall stubs on its own, however
constant the FunctionDescriptors are at the call site (both a hoisted `static final` descriptor
and one built inline were measured, and both give '0 downcalls registered'). Without this file
the image build fails outright while parsing ForeignPty.open with 'unexpected input could not
be handled: linkToNative', and a build that got past that would throw
One entry per DISTINCT descriptor, not per function, in the order they appear below:
int(int, void*, long)    ptsname_r(fd, buffer, length)
int(int, long, void*)    ioctl(fd, TIOCSWINSZ, &winsize) — variadic from argument 2
long(int, void*, long)   read(fd, buffer, length), write(fd, buffer, length)
The types are the canonical layout names from Linker.canonicalLayouts() ('void*' for ADDRESS,
'long' for JAVA_LONG on this LP64 target), and ioctl carries firstVariadicArg because it is
declared variadic and the ABI's register assignment depends on it. A per-entry 'reason' is in
the published schema but the 25.0.2 parser rejects it ('Unknown attribute(s) [reason] in
foreign call'), which is why the mapping lives up here. Change a signature in ForeignPty and
this file changes with it — nothing in the JVM suite will tell you.
